items.title: What Is "Long-Context Networking"? How AI Agents Streamline Business Communication
items.pt:
A professional may have years of project documentation, case studies, recorded demos, and customer success stories. A prospective client may have a detailed business problem, specific constraints, and clear expectations for collaboration. Yet their first exchange often looks like this:

"I'm a senior full-stack developer."

"We're looking for someone who knows React."

Neither statement is wrong. But almost everything that could help them assess a possible collaboration has disappeared.

Busines

items.title: OpenAI, Ramp and Notion jobs API: the Ashby job board API and the pay behind one flag
items.pt:
OpenAI (openai), Ramp (ramp) and Notion (notion) post their jobs on Ashby, and Ashby publishes every job board through a public API with no key and no paging:



curl -s "https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/openai" \
  | jq '(.jobs | length), (.jobs[0] | has("compensation"))'






That printed 808 and false: every OpenAI job in one response of 13.5 MB, and no pay in it. Five things to know, measured on 2026-10-28 with a few seconds between requests.


  
  
  1. The pay needs includeC

items.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
items.pt: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strength

items.title: Heads of Security: Learned Attention Gates Improve Prompt Injection Robustness
items.pt: We introduce Heads of Security (HoS), a prompt injection defense that enforces instruction-data separation via a small set of learned per-head attention gates. HoS learns how each head should redistribute attention between trusted and untrusted tokens, enabling models to reason over untrusted content without following injected instructions. items.title: KPPax: preprocess differentiable kinetic ODE for machine learning in atmospheric chemistry
items.pt: Atmospheric chemical mechanisms are commonly distributed in the language of the Kinetic PreProcessor (KPP), which generates efficient Fortran or C code but does not fit into the differentiable programming frameworks in which machine-learning models are developed. We present KPPax, a kinetic preprocessor that generates differentiable, just-in-time compiled, and vectorisable chemistry code in JAX from mechanisms written in the KPP language. KPPax evaluates the rate law with sparse operations in lo

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.pt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments.
